# Listen2Me

> Free Windows desktop dictation from Hangry Labs. Choose local speech recognition or a compatible ASR endpoint.

- [Downloads and setup]({{ '/#downloads' | absolute_url }}): Windows x64 installation, model downloads and beta signing information.
- [Speech models]({{ '/#choose-your-speech-recognition' | absolute_url }}): CPU, supported NVIDIA acceleration and hosted recognition.
- [Controls]({{ '/#controls' | absolute_url }}): Hold, toggle, hands-free and cancellation shortcuts.
- [Custom phrases]({{ '/#custom-phrases' | absolute_url }}): Presets and alternative wordings for text and explicit key actions.
- [Privacy]({{ '/#privacy-and-updates' | absolute_url }}): Audio destinations, session history and update behavior.
- [Official product website](https://listen2me.hangrylabs.app/).
- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/hangry-labs/Listen2Me/releases).
- [Software licence]({{ '/LICENSE.txt' | absolute_url }}).

Local recognition works offline after model/runtime downloads. Hosted recognition sends audio to the chosen provider. The application is proprietary and free to use. No public account or inference service is hosted by this static website.
